output.reason: [ev-c6ee7d3b73da] says that in v3 Swarm support moved out of the Docker provider into a separate Swarm provider. It also says that a configuration with `providers.docker.swarmMode` (true) is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik from starting. So the subject and the type "removed" are right. The before value "\"true\"" is wrong: it is a quoted string, and the `true` in the evidence is only an example setting, not a prior state of the key. The corrected assertion therefore leaves before out.

correction.statement: In Traefik v3 the Docker provider's static option providers.docker.swarmMode is no longer supported. Swarm support moved to the separate Swarm provider, and setting swarmMode on the Docker provider prevents Traefik from starting.
